Commentary.Commentary: So, a win here means New Zealand Women wrap up the series as they go 3-0 up but we still have two more matches to go. The fourth ODI will be played on 22nd February at 3:30 am (10 pm GMT, previous day). Do join us early for the build up. Till then, goodbye!

Sophie Devine, the victorious skipper of New Zealand, says that they have played outstanding cricket. Mentions that the batters handled the run chase very well. Tells that they are not afraid of chasing down big scores. Adds that they have set high standards in the field. States that they are working as a team and are performing with consistency. Tells that they want to continue the trend of scoring 270+. Informs that she would have liked to get some runs too. Ends by saying that she is proud of the team.

Mithali Raj, the skipper of India, says that they didn't get the partnerships they needed in the middle order. Tells that Deepti Sharma batted really well. Mentions that their batting is doing very well but they need to work on their fielding. Jokes by saying at the end of the series they'll post 300 runs.

Lauren Down is the Player of the Match for her match-winning innings of 64. She says that it is really nice to get out there and get some runs. Mentions that she wasn't feeling much pressure and she just tried to keep it simple. Tells that it is nice to guide the team home in a record chase. Adds that they know India will come back hard on them in the next two games as they are a quality side. Says that they will celebrate this victory but will focus on their upcoming games as well.
... The presentation...

Jhulan Goswami led the bowling compartment and after taking both the openers things dried up for them. They took wickets at regular intervals but also let the partnerships to build up. Amy Satterthwaite was dropped twice and that did not help India much. Although all the bowlers took a wicket each, no one got the big breakthroughs. Mithali Raj did well to shuffle her troops but still, she will feel they were 15-20 runs short.

The pitch was batting friendly and New Zealand made most of it. Both the openers early on went without troubling much. It was then the partnership between Amelia Kerr and Amy Satterthwaite of 103 that helped the White Ferns to steady the ship. Both fell and then it was another big partnership that took them near to the chase. Lauren Down and Katey Martin combined to put 76 runs. The latter fell and it was in the hands of Lauren Down to take her team over the line. She brought up her fifty and was also well supported by Frances Mackay. In the end, her knock turned out to be a match-winning one. A wonderful knock by Lauren Down and she helped her team seal the series.

A hard-fought victory for New Zealand Women and they also seal the 5-match ODI series by going 3-0 up. This is also the second-highest successful chase in the history of the Women's ODI. India gave a good fight but failed to get over the line.

SIX! BANG! Why play a whole over when you can get it done in just a single ball. 6 runs were needed and Lauren Down says no problem, Dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and hammers it straight over the bowler's head for a maximum. Takes her side home in style and New Zealand Women seal the series as well. They win by 3 wickets!

A yorker, on middle. Frances Mackay clips it to deep square leg. She pushes hard for the second run and gets it easily. What a great 49th over for New Zealand Women! 12 runs off it and they just need 6 runs in the final over.
In the blockhole, outside off. Lauren Down jams it out to point for a single.
FOUR! Outstanding placement and the timing was perfect! Length ball, outside off. Lauren Down stands still and swings it to long off for a boundary. Is that the game?
A yorker, on middle. Frances Mackay digs it out to the off side and scampers through.
Full and outside off, Frances Mackay tries to scoop it over but fails to get any bat on it this time.
FOUR! Beauty! Length ball, on off. Frances Mackay uses her feet and tonks it towards the vacant long on region for a boundary.
Again! Loopy ball, outside off. Lauren Down misses her cut. 18 needed off the final two overs! This game is going right down the wire.
Flighted ball, outside off, Lauren Down flashes her bat at it but misses. Taniya Bhatia whips the bails off but Down was inside the crease.
On off, nudged to square leg for one.
Floats it up, on middle. Frances Mackay nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Loopy ball, outside off. Lauren Down smashes it to long off but only for a single.
This is eased down to long on for a single.

Touch fuller, on middle. Lauren Down flicks it to wide of long on. Shafali Verma from deep mid-wicket runs to her left and flicks the ball back in just in time. Good fielding in the deep! Saves two valuable runs for her side. 23 needed from 18!
FIFTY for Lauren Down! What a knock this has been under pressure! Length ball, outside off. Lauren Down slaps it to sweeper cover for a brace. The job is not done yet and she will be aware of that.
On middle, clipped to square leg for a single.
Much better now! Good-length ball, on off. Frances Mackay keeps it out.
On a good length, on middle. Frances Mackay blocks it out.
FOUR! Poor from the experienced Jhulan Goswami! A freebie down leg, Frances Mackay tickles it to fine leg for a boundary.
Change. Jhulan Goswami has two overs left and it will be very crucial for India.
Outside off, cut away to point. Good fielding there! India Women still alive. 32 needed from 24 balls!
This is worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Frances Mackay walks out now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Deepti Sharma made her bat talk and now provides a crucial breakthrough. Could prove to be a match turning wicket. Bowls it short and outside off, Katey Martin hangs back, makes room and looks to cut. The ball goes off the outside edge and Taniya Bhatia does well to pocuch it. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger.
Commentary.Howout: c Taniya Bhatia b Deepti Sharma

Loopy ball, outside off. Lauren Down smacks it to long off only for a single.

Wide! Fuller and down the leg side. Down misses her sweep.

Comes down the track and Martin defends it back.
Flatter and on off. Hit to point for a single.
Length ball, shaping in, outside off. Martin slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Fuller ball, on middle, drilled down to long on for a single.
Wide! Length and way outside off. Left alone.

Full and on middle,eased down to long on for a single.
Around off, fuller, worked to covers.

Fuller and outside off. Martin drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter and on off. Lauren turns it to mid-wicket for a run.
On middle, tucked to square leg for a single.
Around off, pushed to point.
How has that missed the leg stump? Shorter and angling on leg. Down shuffles and gets an inside edge as she looks to flick. It rolls to the leg side for a single.
An arm ball, on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Full again and Down works it to sweeper cover for a single.
Full and angling on middle, pushed  to mid off.
Now slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Full and outside off, driven to deep covers for a single.
Length ball with inward movement on middle. Down pulls it square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
A loopy ball, outside off, this is hit to covers for a single.
Short and outside off. Martin looks to cut but bottom edges it to short third man for a single. That also brings up a 50-run partnership between the batters.
Tossed up, outside off. Martin shuffles and paddles it to deep square leg for a brace.
Flatter and on off. Martin guides it to point.
Fuller and on off. Down charges down and pushes it to long off for a single.
Tossed up, on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full again, on off. Lauren Down drives it to point. New Zealand Women need 64 runs from 60 balls.
Full and on off, eased down to long on for one.
Outside off, Lauren Down works it off the outside edge to third man for a single.
FOUR! Over the top! Lauren Down is growing in confidence! Full and outside off, Lauren Down lifts it over covers and fetches herself a boundary.
Length ball, on off. Lauren Down taps it to point.
On a length, outside off. Pushed towards covers for a single.
Outside off, Katey Martin drives it to sweeper cover and keeps the strike.
Nicely played! Katey Martin was shaping up paddle but in the end, dabs it to third man for a couple of runs.
A full toss, outside off. Lauren Down advances down the wicket and plays it to deep cover for a single.
Outside off, tapped to point for a single.

Floats it up, outside off. Lauren Down looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! Lauren Down has started to attack now! Loopy ball, outside off. Lauren Down shimmies down and lifts it over covers. A couple of bounces and into the fence.
Full and outside off, Katey Martin drives it uppishly towards covers for another single.

A googly, on off. Swept to deep square leg for one.

Loopy ball, on leg. Lauren Down keeps it out.

Flatter ball, outside off. Katey Martin slashes it through covers for a single.

Loopy ball, outside off. Katey Martin paddles it behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Full and on off, driven towards covers for a single.

Tossed up, on middle. Down works it to fine leg for a single.

Katey Martin walks out to bat.

OUT! GONE! The trap was set and Lea Tahuhu fell for it! Serves a short ball, on middle. Lea Tahuhu pulls it hard and flat towards deep square leg where Shafali Verma juggles and takes it. Mithali Raj has been superb with her bowling change.
Commentary.Howout: c Shafali Verma b Ekta Bisht

Short and on off. Green pulls it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Floated gull and on off, pushed to sweeper cover for a couple of runs. A good throw might have been a different story.

On middle, this is flicked to mid-wicket.

Around off, pushed to covers.

Drinks! With that wicket, the umpires have decided to get some refreshments. India Women have got the wicket they were looking for and will look to build more pressure. New Zealand Women still have a decent amount of runs to chase and will need someone to hang on till the end. Lauren Down walks out to bat.

OUT! What a valuable wicket that is! Knowing Kerr, she can take the game away easily but India have done well to take her wicket at a crucial time! This is full and outside off, slower as well. Amelia Kerr looks to slog-sweep it over long on but fails to generate any power. Yastika Bhatia takes it above her head.
Commentary.Howout: c Renuka Singh b Sneh Rana

On middle, blocked out.

Amy Satterthwaite who was negotiating till now nicely looks to go big. She tries to lift it over mid on but fails and Mithali Raj there holds onto it. India get the much needed breakthrough. End of a good innings by Amy Satterthwaite.
Commentary.Howout: c Mithali Raj b Jhulan Goswami

On middle, defended out.

A length ball, on middle. Kerr stays back and nudges it to square leg for a single.
Length and outside off. Left alone.
FOUR! Another superb shot! Length and on off. Amy Satterthwaite punches it past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Releases the pressure! Good shot actually, there was width on offer and Amy Satterthwaite fetches it as she drives it through covers for a boundary.
A length ball, slanting on off. Amy Satterthwaite defends it under her eyes.
A length ball, outside off. Kerr square cuts it wide of gully and to third man for a single.
Length ball, on off. Kerr forces it to covers.
On middle, Blocked out.

DROPPED! Another wicket on the cards but is put down! A length ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite looks to push but it takes the outside edge to Deepti Sharma who is standing near the gully region drops a very easy catch.
Length and outside off. Amy Satterthwaite swings and misses.
Amy Satterthwaite walks out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! Jhulan Goswami you beauty! What an absolute ripper and she gets the other opener for a timid score. This is on a length and on off, it lands and shapes a bit in. Bates, on the front foot, looks to push but leaves the gate open for the ball to fly through and hit the stumps. Another big wicket for India.
A length ball, on off. Kerr taps it to covers where a misfield allows a single to be taken.
Length ball, straight on middle. Kerr defends it.
A length ball, on middle. Bates tries to push it on the leg side but gets a leading edge to covers. Was hit with soft hands.
FOUR! Good shot! Pitches it up, on middle. Bates on drives it past mid on for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off, pushed to point. The throw was a bit wayward but no run stolen there.
Length and angling on middle. Blocked back solidly.
Outside off again, this is driven to deep point for a single.
A full ball, outside off. Kerr looks to drive but misses.
Renuka Singh to bowl from the other end.
Full ball, on middle, pushed to mid on.
Length and on middle. Kerr turns it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on middle, pushed back to the other side of the stumps. Jhulan Goswami gets her right hand out but does not touch the ball.
NO BALL AND FOUR! A yorker, on  middle. Kerr squeezes it out and it goes off the inner portion to the fine leg fence. Jhulan Goswami overstepped and a free hit will follow.
Amelia Kerr walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! LBW! Goswami comes back to the team and strikes straightaway. A length ball, around off and nipping back in. Devine without any feet movement looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. The dangerous Sophie Devine goes without troubling. Just the start India were looking after!
A length ball, straight on middle. Bates tucks it to square leg for a single to get off the mark.
Leg bye! Length ball, angling on the pads. Devine misses her flick. It goes off the pads and to fine leg for a leg bye.
